name: 34448 · Homosassa, FL
findings: ZIP 34448 (Homosassa) has 26 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (45% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 34448 (Homosassa) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 34448 (Homosassa) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.5 times the typical level).
